raw:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT p."ID", p."Birthday", p."Diagnosis"
FROM main."Patient" p
JOIN main."Laboratory" l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l."Date") = 1997
  AND l."GOT" >= 60
ORDER BY p."ID"
```
